description: Move clips as a rigid group to a new start time and/or another track. The destination must be free; nothing is pushed aside.

clipIds.description: Ids of the clips to move.

toStartUs.description: New start of the earliest listed clip, in microseconds (1 second = 1000000); omit to keep times.

toTrackId.description: Target track id; all listed clips must be on one track. Omit to keep tracks.
